name: skytek
description: Writes a Scope of Work from an RFP (docx, pdf, txt, md) or a short interview, filled into one Word template and delivered as .docx and .pdf

outputDir.title: Output folder
outputDir.description: Where the .docx, .pdf and .sow.json files are written; relative paths resolve against the current project

templatePath.title: Template override
templatePath.description: Path to your own docxtpl Word template; empty uses the bundled SkyTek template

vendorName.title: Vendor name
vendorName.description: Your company's legal name on the cover, footer and signature block

vendorAddress.title: Vendor address
vendorAddress.description: Your company's address; empty means the skill asks

vendorSignatoryName.title: Vendor signatory
vendorSignatoryName.description: Who signs SOWs for your company; empty means the skill asks

vendorSignatoryTitle.title: Vendor signatory title
vendorSignatoryTitle.description: Job title of the vendor signatory; empty means the skill asks

vendorOverview.title: Vendor overview
vendorOverview.description: Three or four lines on your company for section 1.1 of every SOW; empty means the skill asks
